_description.ntrip.caster: NTRIP caster hostname or IP address.
_description.ntrip.caster_port: NTRIP caster TCP port. The common default is 2101.
_description.ntrip.mountpoint: NTRIP mountpoint name, without a leading slash unless your caster requires it.
_description.ntrip.password: NTRIP account password. Leave blank to be prompted at run time.
_description.output.type: MAVLink output transport. Use serial for a COM/tty port or ethernet for MAVLink over UDP.
_description.output.serial_port: Serial MAVLink output port used when output.type is serial, for example COM3 or /dev/ttyUSB0. Leave blank to select from a prompt.
_description.output.baud: Serial baud rate used when output.type is serial.
_description.output.ethernet_ip: Remote INS or MAVLink device IP address used when output.type is ethernet.
_description.output.ethernet_port: Remote INS or MAVLink device UDP port used when output.type is ethernet.
_description.output.ethernet_local_ip: Local IP address to bind for MAVLink UDP receive. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces.
_description.output.ethernet_local_port: Local UDP port to listen for MAVLink packets when output.type is ethernet. Use the port the INS sends to, or null for an ephemeral port.
_description.mavlink.gga_interval: Seconds between NMEA GGA position messages sent to the NTRIP caster.
_description.mavlink.position_timeout: Seconds to wait for GPS2_RAW latitude/longitude before falling back to another MAVLink position packet or manual entry.
_description.mavlink.source_system: MAVLink source system ID used by this script.
_description.mavlink.source_component: MAVLink source component ID used by this script.
_description.mavlink.version: MAVLink wire version for outgoing GPS_RTCM_DATA frames. Use 2 unless a receiver requires MAVLink 1.
_description.mavlink.altitude: MSL altitude in meters used in the generated GGA sentence.
_description.mavlink.latitude: Optional manual latitude override in decimal degrees. Leave null to query GPS2_RAW over MAVLink.
_description.mavlink.longitude: Optional manual longitude override in decimal degrees. Leave null to query GPS2_RAW over MAVLink.
